title: Choose the macOS host enforcement mechanism
goal: Measure the candidate mechanisms (macOS sandbox profile, a lightweight VM/container, AgentFS from the 2026-11-09 assessment) against the T01 threat model on the Mac host and record the choice
acceptance: Each candidate checked for filesystem, network egress, credential denial, CPU/memory/output limits, cancellation and startup time
Decision record in docs/decisions with what each candidate cannot enforce
Owner chooses when more than one candidate passes
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
validation: Spike scripts against neutral fixtures; no service activation
escalation: Owner decision: the mechanism, when more than one passes; unsupported enforcement blocks execution, never substituted by a worktree or subprocess

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-11 from the F-049 Check and the execution-boundaries assessment, after the owner asked why only F-049-T01 was planned. Later steps depend on T01/T03 findings; the owner may revise any split. Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 2.25 hours agent + 0.25 hours owner; agent evaluates candidates at the usual rate; the owner chooses when more than one passes. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1.5 kept as history.
